mainEntity.name: How is my fee discount applied?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your discount is applied automatically to every open and close fee when you have an active referral code. No additional action is required after setting the code.

mainEntity.name: Can I change my referral code?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can update your referral code at any time. The new code's discount will apply going forward. Previous trades are not affected.
The discount applies to opening and closing fees on all perpetual positions. Funding rates and price impact are not affected by referral discounts.
Full referral program documentation, tier thresholds, and commission structures are available in the SO4 docs. Look under the Referrals section.
